title: Injectivity of the polynomial threshold profile
statement: For all natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the map sending a polynomial threshold function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube whose representing polynomial has Fourier degree at most $k$ to its low-degree agreement profile for degrees at most $k$ is injective. Thus, two such functions with the same agreement count for every parity function indexed by a subset of size at most $k$ must be equal.
